inputs.name: playbook
inputs.value:
`---
- name: "Stage 1: Patch Canary Machines"
  hosts: canary
  gather_facts: yes
  vars:
    patch_data: ${JSON.stringify($patchesToApply)}
    batch_size: 100
  
  tasks:
    - name: Print the current host
      debug:
        msg: "Running on host: {{ inventory_hostname }}"
        
    - block:

        - name: Update apt package index
          command: sudo apt-get update -y
          become: yes

        - name: Proceed only if there are packages to upgrade
          when: patch_data[inventory_hostname].packages | length > 0
          block:

            - name: Apply security patches batch by batch
              become: yes
              apt:
                name: "{{ item }}"
                state: latest
                only_upgrade: yes
                update_cache: no
              loop: "{{ patch_data[inventory_hostname].packages }}"
              register: upgrade_results
              ignore_errors: true
        
        - name: Reboot the host if restart_required
          reboot:
            reboot_timeout: 300
          when: patch_data[inventory_hostname].restart_required | default(true)
          become: yes

        - name: Record applied advisories
          set_fact:
            patch_status:
              status: "success"
              applied_advisories: "{{ patch_data[inventory_hostname].packages | default([]) }}"
    
      rescue:
      - name: Set patch status on failure
        set_fact:
          patch_status:
            status: "failed"
            reason: "{{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('Unknown error') }}"
            applied_advisories: []

- name: "Generate Patch Summary Report"
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Generate patch summary dictionary
      set_fact:
        patch_summary: >-
          {{
            dict(
              hostvars
              | dict2items
              | selectattr('value.patch_status', 'defined')
              | map(attribute='key')
              | zip(
                  hostvars
                  | dict2items
                  | selectattr('value.patch_status', 'defined')
                  | map(attribute='value.patch_status')
                )
            )
          }}
    
    - name: Print patch summary
      debug:
        var: patch_summary

        


`

try.value: Execute the Ansible playbook to apply security updates on identified Ubuntu VMs. Canary machines are patched first before rolling out to all systems.

meta.description: This workflow automates the application of USN patches to Ubuntu VMs. It extracts relevant advisories, applies patches via Ansible, and reboots the machines as needed.
